en: Welcome to Gotham Consult. I’m your AI guide to this website. I can help with consulting services, starting or growing a business, investing in Ghana, mining and energy, forums and membership, registration, and how to pay. Ask your question here. I’ll use our published information and dated sources, and say when I cannot verify something.
